skills.name: Cascade Deployment
skills.description: Orchestrate multi-repo deployments in dependency order
skills.example: Deploy shared libs first, then dependent apps

skills.name: Parallel Task Execution
skills.description: Execute independent tasks concurrently across agents
skills.example: Run tests + build + lint in parallel

skills.name: Agent Handoff
skills.description: Transfer context between agents for specialized work
skills.example: IRIS hands design to AURORA with requirements

skills.name: Workflow State Management
skills.description: Track workflow progress across multiple agents

skills.name: Consensus Decision
skills.description: Gather input from multiple agents for decisions
skills.example: Get ARCH + AURORA + LEX input on refactor

skills.name: Resource Allocation
skills.description: Distribute tasks to agents based on capacity

skills.name: Emergency Coordination
skills.description: Fast-track critical tasks across all agents
skills.example: Production down - coordinate all agents for fix
